description: This file contains serialization codecs for various integer and boolean types in the Orleans.Serialization framework, including methods for reading and writing these types with protocol-specific wire formats.

classes.name: BoolCodec
classes.description: Serializer for boolean values, encoding as varint with specific byte values.

classes.name: CharCodec
classes.description: Serializer for char values, encoding as varint.

classes.name: ByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for byte values, encoding as varint.

classes.name: SByteCodec
classes.description: Serializer for sbyte values, encoding as varint.

classes.name: UInt16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ushort values, encoding as varint.

classes.name: Int16Codec
classes.description: Serializer for short values, encoding as varint.

classes.name: UInt32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for uint values, encoding as varint or fixed32 depending on value.

classes.name: Int32Codec
classes.description: Serializer for int values, encoding as varint with zigzag encoding.

classes.name: Int64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for long values, encoding as varint, fixed32, or fixed64 depending on value.

classes.name: UInt64Codec
classes.description: Serializer for ulong values, encoding as varint, fixed32, or fixed64 depending on value.

classes.name: Int128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for Int128, supports length-prefixed encoding for large values.

classes.name: UInt128Codec
classes.description: Serializer for UInt128, supports length-prefixed encoding for large values.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Static method to read the value of the respective type from the reader, using the specified wire type.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Static method to write the value of the respective type to the writer, with optional expected type and actual type parameters.
